# MERP-UI 2.0.12 — Creature Lore: The Warg

**Release date:** 20 November 2026.

This release integrates the complete British-English Warg cultural and regional knowledge texts into the prebuilt private Creature Lore RollTable compendium.

## New content

- **Warg Racial Lore:** 60 cultural variants, each with five narrative results (300 results).
- **Warg Region Lore:** 31 geographic variants, each with five narrative results (155 results).
- **91 complete variant tables, 455 narrative outcomes and 91 confidential GM verification notes.**
- The two deliberately misleading failure outcomes remain intact for each culture and region; reliability and editorial verification remain GM-only.

## Foundry and Rolemaster Unified

- Two Warg RollTables have been added to the existing `merp-ui.merp-ui-lore` LevelDB compendium.
- Exact-name Warg/Ouargue Creature Actors in the World are linked automatically; a renamed Warg can be linked through the GM API.
- Cultural selection uses existing MERP-UI culture keys. Regional selection uses the skill's RMU specialization when identifiable and otherwise presents a GM-controlled list of 31 regions.
- Native RMU rolls stay blind/GM-only; only the chosen narrative paragraphs reach the character by private message.
- All **235 existing Wolf results** remain unchanged. No RMU stats, XP, DP, profession, race or skill mechanics have been modified.

The installable ZIP includes all ten prebuilt Compendiums. The Lore LevelDB update is performed offline in GitHub Actions, never against an active World.

**Compatibility:** Foundry VTT 13–14 (declared), RMU 1.3.55+ (declared). A real Foundry two-client end-to-end check is still recommended.

**Credits:** Free, unofficial, non-commercial fan project by Jean-Brice Gayet. Original illustrations created using ChatGPT. See LICENSE and NOTICE.md.
